comments.body: Schema change for callout attrs is straightforward—will mirror the toggle-list collapse flag.

content.text: Schema change for callout attrs is straightforward—will mirror the toggle-list collapse flag.
Writers repeatedly fake callouts with blockquotes and emoji. That breaks consistency and is invisible to our a11y tree as a distinct region.

Add a slash-menu item “Callout” that inserts a collapsible callout block with variants info / warn / success, an optional title, and a chevron that toggles body visibility. Collapsed state is stored on the node attrs and syncs to collaborators.

Ready when slash menu search matches “callout”, “note”, and “warning”; keyboard users can expand/collapse with Enter on the header; export to markdown uses a fenced callout convention we already parse on import.
